identityReview: Matched Transformer coauthor and Character.AI cofounder across arXiv, personal homepage, Reuters, Duke and NEC. Wikipedia confirms American identity. NEC gives 1976, Wikipedia prose gives 1975 or 1976 and its infobox gives 1976; birth omitted pending reconciliation rather than manufacturing a full date.
lifeStatusEvidence: Reuters June 17, 2026 report quotes his announcement of a move to OpenAI and a Google response. His current personal biography identifies him at OpenAI and describes Google roles in the past tense. This supports recent activity; no exact first working day at OpenAI established.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Opened three arXiv abstract and submission-history pages, Reuters via CNA and WSAU, Reuters original August 2024 report, PEOPLE updated report, Michigan attorney general release, personal homepage, Duke departmental news, NEC prize attachment and Wikipedia.
sourceReview.scope: Collaborative technical contributions, paper submission dates, education, changing employment, startup founding, litigation and corporate bankruptcy.
corrections: Current homepage lists OpenAI. June 17 Reuters item explicitly says departure timing was not immediately clear; timeline records announcement, not exact start date. No invented OpenAI executive title.

Reuters August 2024 article is dated August 23 UTC with August 22 San Francisco dateline. Month precision used for return and Gemini appointment. Jeff Dean and Oriol Vinyals retained as co-leads. Licensing and hiring are not described as acquisition of the whole company.

Character.AI founding retained as 2021, jointly with Daniel De Freitas. Product launch is distinct. Senate-hosted 2025 declaration search excerpt specifies approximately November 2021, but full PDF access failed (403, then oversized response); month omitted and that excerpt is not a required source for the published text.

PEOPLE updated January 13, 2026 explicitly reports a joint statement describing settlement in principle. Its January 7 weekday label is inconsistent with the calendar, so month precision is used. Terms undisclosed; settlement does not establish liability. Do not assert every related case is finally dismissed or no further claims remain.

Reuters WSAU report dates filing October 12, 2026; later October 13 publication dates are not substituted. Michigan official October 15 release corroborates corporate bankruptcy and consumer-data concerns. It is not personal bankruptcy and no sale closing or completed shutdown is asserted.
Duke 1998 departmental report identifies class of 1998; NEC also lists 1998 Duke. Mathematics/computer science study corroborated by Wikipedia. No doctorate or fabricated graduation day.

NEC biography says 2000 Google Brain; this conflates later research-unit naming with Google employment. Use Google 2000, corroborated by Reuters and personal homepage, without saying Google Brain existed then.
Personal homepage dates sparsely gated MoE work 2016; arXiv first submission is January 23, 2017. Timeline explicitly dates paper submission, not first invention. All seven coauthors retained.
Transformer first submission is June 12, 2017, distinct from later revisions and conference date. All eight authors share credit. No claim to sole invention or universal model superiority.

Multi-query attention paper is sole-authored, first submitted November 6, 2019. Shared keys/values reduce bandwidth; paper studies quality tradeoffs rather than claiming zero degradation or guaranteed acceleration on every system.

Search snippets suggest NAE membership, but no primary membership record was inspected; omitted from selected milestones. No personal wealth, private family details or unverified current positions imported.
sourceReview.limits: AI authorship and field review, not human/native-language certification. No full litigation docket review or independent technical replication. Character blog returned 404 and Yahoo copies 403/429; use inspected independent sources, not an assertion that those pages were read.

portraitReview.rightsEvidence: Personal homepage contains a portrait but no reusable image license was established in inspected text. Search returned incidental Commons credits on news pages without a verified matching source image.
portraitReview.unresolved: Original research evidence has portrait:null. Identify a licensed portrait, preserve creator/license attribution, obtain image bytes and visually verify identity, color and crop. No downloaded image or completed visual review claimed.

translationReview.scope: All 32 Chinese fields and seven translations reviewed for shared authorship, technical meaning of keys/values and conditional computation, current/former roles, founding versus launch, announcement dates, settlement qualification and corporate versus personal bankruptcy.
